// diagnostic L0516

Jet.MessageText

The default HTTP body text limit is passed through a lower-level body call

What

The default HTTP body text limit is passed through a lower-level body call

Why

Request.text() and response.text() already use the same default cap as body().text(limit)

Fix

Replace body().text(default_limit) with text()

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MessageText: Tests/UILint/message_text.warn.

Warning: Jet.MessageText: The default HTTP body text limit is passed through a lower-level body call
  --> Tests/UILint/message_text.jet:2:11
    |
  2 |     body: req.body().text(1048576) ?? "fallback"
    |           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `request.text()` and `response.text()` already read the body with the same default cap as `body().text(1048576)`
 Fix: Replace `body().text(1048576)` with `text()`
